messages:
miguel: heads up — several GitHub Actions workflows are failing across multiple PRs, looks like 401s from the GH App during job setup. example log: `error: GitHub API request failed (401)`
jamie: saw that, noticed the app install token is returning 401 in the runner logs as well. happening since around 12:03 UTC.
sara: pinging from backend — my feature PR is blocked by this. can someone rerun the matrix job? rerun is failing with the same auth error.
miguel: can someone paste the run link? I want to check the installation id.
sara: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/actions/runs/123456789 — top failures are in `build-and-test` job.
buildbot: [action] Workflow run 123456789 concluded with failure: 401 Unauthorized (setup-node step).
jamie: I bisected quickly: older runs from two days ago used the same app token and were fine; something changed in our org-level integration rights or the GitHub App private key might have been rotated/revoked.
mitigation?
miguel: short-term: we can trigger a PAT-based fallback for CI for the org to unstick jobs, but we should re-install or re-create the GH App installation token. I'm going to check the app installation page.
-anita: I'm on call for app installs — checking the org settings now. 12:12 UTC: I see the app at "Redwood CI" shows "Pending authorization" for one repo? that's odd.
jamie: could be someone revoked access during cleanup. any recent automation that touched repo settings?
sara: we had an org-bot that cleaned stale integrations last week, cc @platform-security to confirm.
miguel: if install got unapproved, the app returns 401 on jwt->installation-token exchange. Anita, can you try re-approving the app for the affected repo set?
-anita: re-approved for org, reinstalled on the three repos with failing runs.
buildbot: [action] New install event received.
jamie: thank you — can someone rerun one of the failing runs to confirm?
sara: re-run triggered: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/actions/runs/123456790 (manual rerun by sara)
buildbot: [action] Rerun started.
miguel: while that runs, I'll kick off a quick bisect across our infra deploys to see if any automation rotated keys. if it's not automation, we'll update our runbook to require app install slack alert.
jamie: rerun green on the matrix job so install fix worked. :tada:
sara: works for my PR, thanks.
miguel: follow-ups: (1) anita, please add a short postmortem note in #incidents with timeline and who re-approved; (2) jamie, can you add an alert in the CI monitor for "GH App install changed" event and link to runbook; (3) I'll open a tiny infra PR to add a fallback PAT secret so we can unstick when install is revoked.
-anita: noted, adding incident stub. will include steps to re-install and contact list.
jamie: adding CI monitor alert now. will also add a small troubleshooting checklist to the eng-infra runbook.
miguel: thanks all. main cause: GH App installation lost approval -> 401s in runner -> CI red. Root fix applied by re-approving install; follow-ups are alerts and fallback.
sara: tagging for visibility: @platform-security @sre :thumbsup:
